formats.key: buyShares(bytes32 marketId, uint8 option, uint256 amount)
effects: The signer sends `amount` CSMXA (0x5e96…bC5) to the PredictionMarket contract through safeTransferFrom, which spends the signer's CSMXA allowance to this contract.
The signer gets `amount` shares on option `option` of market `marketId`, 1:1 with the CSMXA paid.
formats.shown: Bet 500 CSMXA on option 2, with the market id and the option index as raw values.

findings.title: buyShares shows the market as a raw bytes32 id and the option as a zero-based index with no name.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol buyShares: `require(option < m.optionCount, "Invalid option")`; option names are not stored on chain. Descriptor: `"path": "option", "label": "Option index", "format": "raw"`, `"path": "marketId", "format": "raw"`.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can decode. Optionally relabel the field to 'Option index (starts at 0)'.

cases.notes: Synthetic case, no mined tx. Token constant matches the immutable csmxaToken on Arbitrum. 500 CSMXA out to the contract and shares on option 2 are both shown.

effects: The signer receives CSMXA from the contract: their winning shares × totalPool / winningPool, minus the platform fee and the creator fee (both read from storage).
The claimed flag is set for the signer on this market, so they cannot claim again.
formats.shown: Claim CosmiX Predict winnings for a raw market id; no amount and no token.

findings.title: claimWinnings: the payout amount and the fee cut come from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol _calculateWinnings: `grossWin = (userShares * m.totalPool) / winningPool; ... netWin = grossWin - platformFee - creatorFee`; descriptor only shows `marketId` raw.

findings.title: claimWinnings intent does not name the CSMXA token that the signer receives.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol claimWinnings: `csmxaToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, winAmount)`; descriptor intent "Claim winnings", interpolatedIntent "Claim CosmiX Predict winnings".
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Claim CSMXA winnings from CosmiX Predict".

cases.notes: Synthetic. The claim direction is shown; the amount is storage-derived and not shown.

effects: The signer receives CSMXA equal to the sum of all their shares across every option of the cancelled market.
All the signer's shares in the market are set to zero and the market is marked refunded for them.
formats.shown: Refund bet from a cancelled market, with a raw market id.

findings.title: refundBet says 'Refund bet' but refunds every bet of the signer in that market at once.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol refundBet: `for (uint8 i = 0; i < m.optionCount; i++) { ... totalRefund += optShares; }` then `csmxaToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, totalRefund)`; interpolatedIntent "Refund bet from a cancelled market".
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Refund all your CSMXA bets in a cancelled market".

cases.notes: Synthetic. Refund direction shown; amount is from storage.

effects: The contract sends the platform share of the market fees in CSMXA to the treasury (storage).
The contract sends the creator share in CSMXA to the market creator (storage); the signer receives it only when the signer is the creator.
The market's feesWithdrawn flag is set.
formats.shown: Withdraw market fees for a raw market id.

findings.title: withdrawFees splits fees to treasury and creator from storage; the owner signer receives nothing itself.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol withdrawFees: `if (platformShare > 0) csmxaToken.safeTransfer(treasury, platformShare); if (creatorShare > 0) csmxaToken.safeTransfer(m.creator, creatorShare);`; interpolatedIntent "Withdraw market fees".
findings.fix: Optionally change interpolatedIntent to "Send market fees to treasury and creator".

cases.notes: Synthetic. Recipients and amounts come from storage.

effects: The creator fee of an active market the signer created changes to newFeeBps (max 500 bps); this fee is cut from winners' payouts and later goes to the signer as creator.
formats.shown: Set creator fee to 3% for a raw market id.

formats.key: createMarket(bytes32 marketId, address creator, string title, uint8 optionCount, uint256 endTime, uint256 creatorFeeBps)
effects: A resolver or the owner creates a new market with the given id, creator, title, option count, end time and creator fee; no asset moves.
formats.shown: Create market "<title>" with id, creator, title, options, end date and creator fee %.

cases.notes: Synthetic. All parameters shown with right formats.

effects: A resolver sets the market to Resolved with winningOption as winner and opens a 30-day claim window; this decides who receives the pool.
formats.shown: Resolve market: option N wins, with a raw market id.

findings.title: resolveMarket shows the winning option as a zero-based index with no option name.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol resolveMarket: `require(winningOption < m.optionCount)`; descriptor `"path": "winningOption", "format": "raw"`. Option names are not on chain.
findings.fix: Optionally relabel the field to 'Winning option (index from 0)'.

effects: A resolver sets an active market to Cancelled, which enables refunds for all bettors.
formats.shown: Cancel CosmiX Predict market, with a raw market id.

effects: Anyone can call it after the claim deadline: the contract sends the user's unclaimed net winnings in CSMXA to the treasury, and marks the user as claimed. Nothing of the signer's moves.
formats.shown: Expire unclaimed winnings of <user>, with a raw market id and the user address.

findings.title: expireUnclaimed intent does not say the user's winnings go to the treasury.
findings.evidence: PredictionMarket.sol expireUnclaimed: `claimed[marketId][user] = true; ... csmxaToken.safeTransfer(treasury, winAmount);`; interpolatedIntent "Expire unclaimed winnings of {user}".
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Send unclaimed winnings of {user} to treasury".

cases.notes: Synthetic. No effect on the signer's assets; the forfeit of the user's winnings is named but the destination is not.

effects: The owner sets the platform fee rate (max 500 bps) cut from every winning payout.
The owner sets the treasury that receives platform fees and expired winnings.
The owner grants the resolver role: it can create, resolve and cancel markets.
The owner revokes the resolver role of the address.
The owner hands contract ownership to newOwner in one step; the signer loses all owner rights (fees, treasury, resolvers, pause).
The owner pauses the contract: createMarket and buyShares revert; claims and refunds still work.
The owner unpauses the contract so markets can be created and bets placed again.
